claim.text: In a managed bag-cultivation experiment at the National Mushroom Development Institute in Savar, Bangladesh, a substrate containing 50% waste tea leaves and 50% sawdust produced a reported total biological yield of 189.50 ± 3.31 g per packet across two flushes, with 79% biological efficiency. The table reports means from three replicates. This result is limited to the tested cultivation setup and does not describe wild fungal ecology or performance across other substrates and conditions.

newRecords.identityScope: Exact accepted COL26.8 species usage 9XW87. The biological evidence concerns cultured juveniles in one replicated 30-day tank experiment; it does not characterize wild populations or all aquaculture systems.

claim.text: In a 30-day tank experiment, juvenile P. vannamei sourced from an aquaculture farm in Pingtan, Fujian, China, were stocked at 30 shrimp per tank in two triplicate groups. Tanks receiving Bacillus licheniformis strain FS051 in the water every five days (5 × 10^4 CFU/mL) had significantly higher reported length, weight, survival, and yield and lower feed conversion ratio than control tanks (p < 0.05). The result applies to this cultured stock, dose, and tank experiment, not to wild shrimp or aquaculture systems generally.
claim.textZh: 在一项为期 30 天的水槽试验中，来自中国福建平潭某养殖场的凡纳滨对虾幼体按每槽 30 尾分为两个各有三次重复的处理组。每五天向水中添加地衣芽孢杆菌 FS051（5 × 10^4 CFU/mL）的水槽，相较对照槽报告了显著更高的体长、体重、存活率和产量，以及更低的饲料系数（p < 0.05）。该结果仅适用于这批养殖个体、该剂量和水槽试验，不代表野生对虾或一般养殖系统。

claim.placeTimeScope: Juveniles obtained from an aquaculture farm in Pingtan, Fujian, China; controlled tank experiment at approximately 13‰ salinity; 30 days; trial dates not reported.
claim.lifeStatus: Cultured juvenile shrimp; the experiment did not study wild populations.

newRecords.identityScope: Exact accepted COL26.8 species usage 4S9ML. The biological evidence concerns age-specific body-mass observations of wild monkeys in one monitored reserve population in Yunnan; it does not establish range-wide sexual dimorphism or population-level survival and behavior.

claim.text: For eight-year-old wild black-and-white snub-nosed monkeys monitored at Baimaxueshan National Nature Reserve, the study reports a sexual dimorphism in body mass ratio of 1.85: males averaged 21.8 ± 2.2 kg (n=35) and females 11.8 ± 1.2 kg (n=116), with p < 0.001. The age-sex category counts are study observations, not counts of distinct animals: the methods treat repeated annual records of the same monkey as separate samples. This result is bounded to that monitored population and measurement design.
claim.textZh: 在云南白马雪山国家级自然保护区监测的野生黑白仰鼻猴中，研究报告八岁年龄组的体重性二型比为 1.85：雄性平均 21.8 ± 2.2 千克（n=35），雌性平均 11.8 ± 1.2 千克（n=116），p < 0.001。年龄—性别组样本数是研究观测记录数，并非不同个体的数量；方法部分将同一只猴子跨年度的重复记录分别作为样本。该结果受限于这一监测种群和测量设计。
claim.locator: Abstract; Results §3.1 and Figure 5 for the age-eight ratio, body-mass means, sample sizes and significance; Methods for study locality, record period, and repeated annual observations.
claim.placeTimeScope: Baimaxueshan National Nature Reserve, Weixi County, Yunnan, China; body-mass records collected January 2010–March 2013; wild monkeys in the monitored study population.
claim.lifeStatus: Wild monkeys observed in one monitored reserve population; age-specific category counts may include repeated annual records of individuals.
